candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image 1 is the old game sprite to REBUILD with corrected ground projection. Reference image 2 is the exact geometric construction template; obey its four outer corners and all grid axes precisely, replace template with realistic thin grey stone paving and remove magenta and grid guide marks. Produce ONE Ming north China gambling hall, preserving image 1 grey brick flush hard-gabled roof, realistic grey tiles and wood detail, three open front bays with exactly two wooden gaming tables, bowls and tiny ivory counters, no people. Geometry is the priority: exact 2:1 dimetric, x ground axes at +0.500 and -0.500 slopes (26.565 degrees from horizontal), vertical walls straight vertical, orthographic no vanishing point. Ground footprint 10 by 8: left-to-front edge length 1.25 times front-to-right edge; use same 1536x1152 framing as image 2 and stone ground vertices L=(192,640), F=(832,960), R=(1344,704), B=(704,384). Three visible stone foundation corners must remain fully visible and readable with building inside pad. The pad must be flush 2-3 pixel thick, no thick plinth. Door/window beams follow template axes. Realistic painted strategy-game sprite matching reference material density, natural light upper left. True transparent RGBA surroundings with zero alpha outside building and stone pad. No shadows beyond footprint, no white background, no text, labels, watermark, modern items. Entire roof uncut. Rebuild correct perspective; do not inherit old incorrect wide-shallow footprint.

Use case: sketch-to-render. Fill this precise ground footprint with one realistic Ming dynasty northern China gambling house GAME MAP SPRITE. The input geometry is the lock: KEEP the existing grey polygon vertices and its exact +0.5 and -0.5 edge slopes unchanged. It is a 10 by 8 rectangle in strict orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, not ordinary 30degree isometric. Render grey pavers on it, remove magenta outline, build the building vertically upon it. Do not shrink depth or elongate facade. Facade direction follows lower-left-to-bottom diagonal, side direction follows bottom-to-right diagonal. The visible front edge must remain 1.25 times the visible right edge, and both edges must have absolute slope 0.500. Grey-brick single-story deep hall, three wooden open facade bays with two gaming tables and ivory counters, hard-gabled grey tiled roof with FLUSH brick gable end walls (yingshan), no curved roof tips. Realistic hand-painted high-detail strategy sprite, fine brick/tile/wood detail, sober warm grey stone, brown wood, light upper left, vertical pillars. Keep entire thin rectangular paved foundation perimeter clearly visible, do not place any step outside it. Roof compact enough to stay within image. Transparent zero-alpha background, no white background, no ground shadows beyond footprint. No people, no text, no signage, no labels, no watermark. The geometry template must be obeyed more closely than stylistic preferences.
